messages:
alex: Noticed repeated saturations on model-prod-4 in us-west over the last 30m. SLOs creeping. Thinking we should do automatic 'overflow escape' to a quantized variant instead of queueing/429. Proposal below. Thoughts?

jia: Is this steady capacity or short bursts? can you paste the telemetry snippet?

alex: Short snippet from today: p95 latency jumped to 2.4s when pool_util > 85%. Capacity appears sustained for ~3m windows. Quick rule idea:
```json
{
  "when": "saturation>0.8 AND tier!='enterprise'",
  "action": "route_variant",
  "variant_preference": ["prod-4-q8", "prod-4-q4", "prod-3"]
}
```

sam: We should factor in per-tier latency SLOs. For enterprise, prefer queuing or spill-to-dedicated before dropping to q4. For free/standard tiers, escape earlier.

emily: If we enable auto-escape, Console needs to show when a request was escaped and which variant was used, plus a per-customer opt-out. :eyes: Audit log required.

jia: Quick telemetry query results:
- us-west GPU pool: avg util 78%, spikes to 92%
- p50/p95 latency before escape: 0.6s / 1.1s
- p95 during saturation: 2.4s
I'll add escape_count and last_escape_variant fields to the route metrics.

ops-bot: Alert: us-west GPU pool saturated 3x in the last hour. Incident link: https://internal.kibana/alerts/5873 (auto-generated)

sam: Algorithm thought: compute a variant score = alpha * estimated_latency_increase + beta * quality_loss + gamma * (tier_penalty). Pick the lowest score variant that fits capacity; fallback to queueing only if no variant yields acceptable latency for the tier.

alex: Also add a circuit-breaker per-customer: if escapes > 3 in 10m, start backoff and notify customer via webhook. Don't let automatic escapes hide sustained demand.

emily: I'll prototype Console controls:
- toggle: Auto overflow escape (on/off)
- threshold slider (0.6-0.95)
- per-route overrides (allow enterprise opt-out)
- panel: recent escapes, quality delta, audit link

jia: I'll wire telemetry with tags: escape_count, escape_reason (capacity|latency|quota), source_pool, variant_selected, route_id. Also propose a 2-week canary flag: rollout_percent.

alex: sgtm. Let's capture this as a short RFC: define metrics, algorithm, console UX, and rollout plan (5% non-enterprise -> monitor 48h -> 25% -> 100%). @sam can you draft pseudo-algo and cost function? I'll open the RFC and own the console PR.

sam: On it — drafting pseudo-algo now and will post PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
